protocol.question: At identical recorded states, estimated contacts, references and controller history, does the retained startup shaft-feedback row materially change the native controller request?
protocol.primary: Swap only feedback gain row zero; hold all other rows, stored errors and references fixed.
secondary: Swap shaft gain row and equilibrium command together; label diagnostic
protocol.boundary: Native requested and native amplitude-clipped command only. On B datasets this is the observed motor-input pipeline. On P datasets this is a native-policy shadow at recorded P states, not a reoptimized final P command.
protocol.mapping: delta_pre = delta_equilibrium - delta_K0_times_error; delta_request = diag(f,f,f,1,1) * (1-sync_weights) * delta_pre; counterfactual_native_applied = clip(original_native_request + delta_request, -bounds, bounds)
forbidden_shortcuts: No reset or whole-design swap at saved states
Do not freeze additive transition/fade deltas when their input changes
Do not call P native-clipped counterfactual its final applied command
No inference of new trajectories or improved stability from fixed-state command differences
protocol.threshold_interpretation: Report absolute-unit and cap-normalized engineering resolutions independently. These are not physical benefit or acceptance gates.
required_controls: Hash inputs and source before outcomes
Validate dimensions, time grid, finite fields and caps
Check anchor row/trim within-trace constancy and B/P agreement
Record exact coefficient identity before tolerance comparisons
Recompose actual native request, clipping, LQR and recorded stages
Actual-anchor swap must reproduce actual native output
Use exact_native_clipping_command_delta rather than final P clipping delta
Independently reproduce key arithmetic and outcome classifications
protocol.fade_handling: Recover fade from exact pre-fade request, exact fade delta and exact state/reference damping where identifiable; close all torque components and confirm float32 recording consistency. If unidentifiable, retain and propagate the float32 rounding interval; never label rounded telemetry exact. Report counts and counterfactual uncertainty.
protocol.null_result: A zero or below-resolution anchor effect is a valid result. If found, correct the earlier practical attribution to retained startup gains; the phase dependence of complete physical runs remains real but mechanically/history confounded.
required_outputs: Full-rate compact inputs and counterfactual derivatives
Raw and clipped command differences by fixed window
